payroll is only one minor line."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Sells cloud payroll and HCM software per employee to US employers with payroll tax filing, the same business as Paycom."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Develops application, data and infrastructure software for IT departments, not HR or payroll software."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone, meetings and contact center software for businesses, unrelated to HCM or payroll."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise social media and customer experience software for marketing and service teams, not HR or payroll."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Investment management, fund administration and back-office software for financial firms, not HCM or payroll."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Work management, content and records software for enterprises and government, not HCM or payroll."}]}
